lines: In place in place by sages all was made whose dwellings and which dwells; everywhere this he by himself Candracūḍa; that I think for accomplishment of all desired siddhi not for accomplishment; from Kashmir then supreme city of full practice not for satisfaction.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sthāne sthāne munibhirakhilaiścakrire yannivāsā yaccādhyāste pratipadamidaṃ sa svayaṃ candracūḍaḥ tanmanye@haṃ samabhilaṣitāśeṣasiddhernasiddhyai kaśmīrebhyaḥ paramatha puraṃ pūrṇavṛtterna tuṣṭyai
